name: Laplacian Pyramid Residual
description: Analyzes Laplacian pyramid residual energy distribution across scales (Burt & Adelson, 1983).
mechanism:
이 방법은 applies the Burt-Adelson Laplacian pyramid decomposition to analyze multi-scale residual structures:

1. **GaussianPyramidConstruction**: The image is iteratively low-pass filtered and downsampled by factor 2 to build a Gaussian pyramid G₀, G₁, ..., Gₙ. Each level captures progressively coarser spatial information.

2. **LaplacianResidual계산**: Each Laplacian level Lₖ = Gₖ − expand(Gₖ₊₁) captures the band-pass detail lost between consecutive Gaussian levels. These residuals encode edges, textures, and fine structures at each spatial scale.

3. **Cross-Scale상관분석**: Natural images exhibit characteristic statistical dependencies between Laplacian pyramid levels — adjacent scales show predictable correlation patterns governed by the 1/f power spectrum of natural scenes. AI 생성 images often violate these cross-scale relationships.

4. **Kurtosisand분포Profiling**: The coefficient distributions at each pyramid level are analyzed. Natural image Laplacian coefficients follow a leptokurtic (heavy-tailed) distribution well modeled by generalized Gaussian. GAN/diffusion artifacts produce deviations from these expected distributions.

5. **ResidualEnergy점수 산출**: The energy (sum of squared coefficients) at each level is computed and compared against natural image statistics. 비정상적인 energy distributions across scales indicate synthetic generation or manipulation.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적
